devIpAdajalaM piban । na jAtu jananIgarBe gacCediti viniScayaH” dIvIBAgava॰ “aparADaM paraM kftvA devIBaktasya ko naraH । suKaM laBeta yadapi Bavet trAtA SivaH svayam” iti devIBAga॰ 3 kftABizekAyAM rAjamahizyAm amaraH । 4 mUrvAyAM 5 pfkkAyAM ca medi॰ । 6 dvijastrIRAmupADiBede “devyantASca striyaH sarvA dAsyantAH SUdrayonayaH” karmavipAkaH । 7 AdityaBaktAyAM 8 liNginyAM 9 banDyAkarkowakyAM 10 SAlaparRyAM 11 mahAdroRyAM 12 pAWAyAM 13 nAnaramustAyAm । 14 mfgervArukAyAM 15 harItakyAm 16 atasyAM 17 SyAmAnAmaKage ca strI rAjani॰ । 18 ravisaMkrAntO tatkAlasya yaTA devIsvarUpatvam taTA ekAdaSIta॰ niraRAyi yaTA “atItAnAgato Bogo nAqyaH paYcadaSa smftAH । sAnniDyantu Bavet tatra grahARAM saMkrame raveH । vyavahAro Bavelloke candrasUryopalakzitaH । kAle vikalpate sarvaM brahmARqaM sacarAca ram । pURyapApaviBAgena PalaM devI prayacCati । ekADikakftaM tasmin kowikowiguRaM Bavet । DarmAdvivardDate hyAyUrAjyaM putrasuKAdi ca । aDarmAdvyADiSokAdi vizuvAyaRasanniDO । vizuvezu ca yaddattaM japtaM Bavati cAkzayam । evaM vizRupade cEva zaqaSItimuKezu ca” devIpu॰ । “BogovyAptiH sUkzmasaMkramaRakAlasanniDAne puRyatamatvamiti yAvaditi kalpataruH । vastutastu Bujyata iti Bogo BogyaH ravisaMkramaRe atItAnAgataH kAlo BogyastannimittapuRyapApajananayogya iti yAvat । ataeva puRyapApaviBAgena PalamityupasaMhftam । sa kAlaH kiyAnityAha । nAqyaH paYcadaSeti uBayataH paYcadaSadaRqapuRyatvaM divA vizRupadIvizayamiti tiTitattve vakzyate । sAnniDyamityAdinA tasyEva kAlasya stutiH । vikalpate svaBAvAt pracyavate । devI saMkrAntikAlasvarUpA saMkrAntyupakrame devIpurARa eva “samAyanamfturmAsaH pakzohaSca krameRa tu । sTUlasUkzmaviBAgena devI sarvagatA viBo!” । ityaBiDAnAt “kalAkAzWAdirUpeRa pariRAmapradAyinI” iti mArkaRqeyapurARAcca” raGu॰ । tatra kftABizekAyAM rAjamahizyAm “snAto'nuliptaH suraBiH sragvI ruciraBUzaRaH । snAtAM viSudDavasanAM gacCeddevIM suBUzaRAm । na hi devIgfhaM gacCedAtmIyAt sanniveSanAt । atyarTavallaBo'pIha viSvAsaM strIzu na vrajet । devIgfhagataM BrAtA BadrasenamamArayat । mAtuHSayyAntare lInaM kArUzaYcOrasaM sutam । lAjAn vizeRa saMyojya maDuneti viloqitaH । devI tu kASIrAjendraM nijaDAna rahogatam” kAma॰ nIti॰ ।
m: देवी f. (cf. देव) a female deity, goddess, RV.; AitBr.; MBh. &c. (e.g. Uṣas, RV. vii, 75, 5; Sarasvatī, v, 41, 17; Sāvitrī, the wife of Brahmā, MBh.; Durgā, the wife of Śiva, MBh.; Hariv.; Kāv. &c.; the 4 goddesses of Buddhists are Rocanī, Māmakī, Pāṇḍurā and Tārā, Dharmas. iv)
N. of nymph beloved by the Sun, L.
(with Jainas) the mother of 18th Arhat of present Ava-sarpiṇī, L.
queen, princess lady (the consecrated wife or daughter of a king, but also any woman of high rank), MBh.; Kāv. &c.
a kind of bird (= श्यामा), L.
a partic. supernatural power (= कुण्डलिनी), Cat.
N. of plants (colocynth, a species of cyperus, Medicago Esculenta &c.), L.
a: देवी — 1 A female deity, a goddess. --2 N. of Durgā. --3 N. of Sarasvatī. --4 N. of Sāvitrī. --5 A queen, especially a crowned queen ( अग्रमहिषी who has undergone the consecration along with her husband); प्रेष्यभावेन नामेयं देवीशब्दक्षमा सती . स्नानीयवस्त्रक्रियया पत्त्रोर्णं वोपयुज्यते M. 5. 12; देवीभावं गमिता परिवारपदं कथं भजत्येषा K. P. 10. --6 A respectful title applied to a lady of the first rank. --Comp. --कोटः the city of Bāṇa, (शोणितपुर). --गृहं {1} the temple of a goddess. {2} the apartment of a queen.

k.v: राजा भट्टारको देवस्तत्सुता भर्तृदारिका। देवी कृताभिषेकायामितरासु तु भट्टिनी॥
जीवन्तिका सोमवल्ली विशल्या मधुपर्ण्यपि। मूर्वा देवी मधुरसा मोरटा तेजनी स्रवा॥
मरुन्माला तु पिशुना स्पृक्का देवी लता लघुः। समुद्रान्ता वधूः कोटिवर्षा लङ्कोपिकेत्यपि॥

na॰ devyAH taddevatAkaM sUktamfkasamudAyaH । fgvede SAkalasaMhitAyAmatiprasidDe devIdevatAke 1 sUktaBede “rAtrisUktaM japedAdO maDye saptaSatIM japet । prAnte tu japanIyaM vE devIsUktamiti kramAt” marIcikalpaH । tatrEva puraScaraRaprakaraRe “kfzRAzwamIM samAraBya yAvat kfzRacaturdaSIm । vfdDyEkottaramAjApyaM pUrvasaMpuwitaM tat । evaM devyA yaTA proktaH pOraScaraRikaH kramaH । tadante havanaM kuryAt pratiSlokena pAyasam । rAtrisUktaM prati fcaM taTA devyASca sUktakam । hutvAnte prajapet stotramAdO pUjAdikaM mune!” atra guptavatIkArA AhuH । “pUrvasaMpuwitam pUrvAByAM pUrvoktAByAM rAtrisUktadevIsUktAByAM saMpuwitam” pratiSlokeneti mantraviBAgopalakzaRam kAtyAyanyAditantroktasaptaSatIviBAgagranTasya havanAdiviDiM prati vAkyaSezatvena tenEva bEDapadArTanirRayAvaSyamaBAvAt । rAtrisUktadevIsUkte ca fgvede SAkalasaMhitAyAM prasidDe । taTetyanena jape kxptakramaH saMpuwAkAro nirdiSyate tacCabdasya pUrvaparAmarSitvAt । tasya SlokapUraRamAtrArTatvaM tuna nyAyyam । dvAByAmapi sUktAByAM trirAvfttasaptaSatIhomottarameva pAWakramAnusAreRa homaH । “viSveSvarIM jagadDAtrImiti” stavo rAtrisUktam । “namodevyE mahAdevyE iti” stavo devIsUktamiti kaScit tanna “pratiSlokaM pratifcamiti” pratiniyatanirdeSaviroDAt fksUktAdiSabdAnAM vEdikamantrezveva rUQatvaprasidDeH । matsyasUktamityAdi kvAcitkatAntrikavyavahArasya kevalayOgikatvenopapatteH । tena fkpadasya Sloke lakzaRetyuktirapi sAhasamAtram । samudramanoDyAnAdiviDO vfhadraTantarapadayoH pratiniyatanirdeSabalAdeva lakzaRAvyavasTAyA iva prakfte kxptAyA eva SaktervyavasTAdArQyasya kEmutikanyAyenEva sidDeH । yadi tvevamAlocyate “viSveSvaryyAdikaM sUktaM dfzwaM tadbrahmaRA purA । stutaye yoganidrAyA mama devyAH purandara! । mahizAntakarIsUktaM sarvasidDipradaM taTA । devyA yayAdikaM divyaM dfzwaM devEH saharziBiH । devi! prapannArttihare! prasIdetyAdikaM taTA । nArAyaRIstutirnAma sUktaM paramaSoBanam । amuzyAH stutaye dfzwaM vrahmAdyEH sakalEH surEH । namo devyAdikaM sUktaM sarvakAmaPalapradam” iti viSaPalitavezeRa pAYcarAtralakzmItantre vyavahAradarSanAdetezAM stotrARA mapOruzeyatvasya sidDAntitatvAcca sUktatvavyavahAro yujyata eveti । tadA kAtyAyanItantramate viSveSvarImiti SlokAt pUrvaM brahmovAcetyasya pAWABAvAttaduttarameva tatpAWAcca । tvaM svAhetyAraByEva stotrAramBaH tasya ca yoganidrAtmakarAtridEvatatvAt marIcitantre rAtrisUktapadena nirdeSa iti samADeyaM paraM tvetattantramanusaratA viSveSvarImiti Sloke'NgahomadaSAyAM na hotavyam । stotrAntimaSlokasya dveDA viBAgo'pi na kAryaH । devIsUkte'pi treDA viBAgo'Ngahome na viDeyaH praDAnaviDiSezasyANgaviDAvanvayena pratifcamiti pade lakzaRAkalpane mAnABAvAdityavaDeyam” । 2 namodevyE mahAdevyE ityAdike devImAhAtmyasya paYcamADyAyasTe devyAH stutirUpe mAlAmantre ca “sa ca vESyastapastepe devIsUktaM paraM japan” devImAhA॰ tatra guptavatIkArA AhuH “devIsUktaM bahvfcezvatiprasidDamekaM । viSveSvarImityAdItyeke SrIsUktamATarvaRaprasidDa mityanye । vastutastu devIsUktaM namodevyA ityAdika paYcamADyAyasTaM stutirUpaM tacca sarvadevatAkUwasTAyA mahAlakzmyAH stotraM SumBAdivaDArTiBirbrahmAdiBirdevErdfzwaM sarvakleSaparihArESvaryyAdiPalakaM tatkAmAByAM tAByAM japtam anupadaM SrutatvAt budDisannihitatvAccedameva devIsUktapadenAtra gfhItumucitaM lakzmItantrasammataScAyamarTaH iti prAgeva nirUpitamityapare “prARADaH saMsTitaM vIjaM vyoma vIjaM hutASanaH । trikoRavindunAdAQyaM praRavAdi namo'ntakam । ambikAsidDidaM jYeyaM devIsUktaM paraM smftam” iti kvacitpaWite 3 mantraBede ca ।
